## Sovereign Collections (7,000,000 Volumes Total)
- [General Applied Knowledge Encyclopedia (5,000,000 Volumes, GID 1–5,000,000)](https://million.elnemer-ai.com/?collection=general): 50 Sectors, 1,000 Disciplines, 78 Languages. Harvard Dataverse DOI: `doi:10.7910/DVN/TTKZSO`.
- [Artificial Intelligence & Future Computing Cloud Encyclopedia (1,000,000 Volumes, GID 5,000,001–6,000,000)](https://million.elnemer-ai.com/?collection=ai): 10 Sectors (#51–#60), 200 AI Disciplines, 78 Languages. Harvard Dataverse DOI: `doi:10.7910/DVN/FZISTQ`.
- [Ancient Egypt & Pharaohs Civilization Cloud Encyclopedia (1,000,000 Volumes, GID 6,000,001–7,000,000)](https://million.elnemer-ai.com/?collection=pharaohs): 10 Sectors (#61–#70), 200 Egyptology Disciplines, 78 Languages. Harvard Dataverse DOI: `doi:10.7910/DVN/UFYQDK`.
